Definition: Mikmas or Mikmash, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Saul chose three thousand men, two thousand with him in Michmash and a thousand with Jonathan in Gibeah, and the Philistines were smitten from Michmash to Aijalon. After the exile the children of Benjamin dwelt at Michmash again. It is a town of Benjamin on the ridge, fought over and lived in again.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Michmash is the town that keeps coming back: Saul held it, Jonathan fought from it, and after the exile Benjamin dwelt there again.
